query:
with total_amount_per_person as (
SELECT 
  TIV.violator_id, 
  sum(`actual_fine`) as sum_amount
FROM 
  `estishraf_llm_traffic_violation` TIV
WHERE 
  YEAR(TIV.`gdate_happened`) = 2024
  AND TIV.`status_description` IN ('Issued to violator and paid', 'Issued to violator but un-paid')
group by 1
    )
    select 
    avg(sum_amount) avg_sum_amount
    from total_amount_per_person LIMIT 1200
raw_question: ما هو متوسط قيمة المخالفات المرورية للفرد خلال عام 2024
